name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

changes.title: 5 Things to Know About Tom Tiffany, Republican Gubernatorial Candidate in Wisconsin
changes.summary: Representative Tom Tiffany is running with President Trump’s backing.

changes.title: Rubio, Bessent and Miller Traveled on Decoy Plane From Turkey Without Trump
changes.summary: Some of President Trump’s top officials traveled on the original Air Force One, which the president secretly disembarked.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Voters in a half a dozen states went to the polls Tuesday, report suggests President Trump switch aircraft due to threat as he was leaving NATO, Iraq's leader wants to disarm Iran-backed militias.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with former Secret Service agent Robert McDonald about reports that President Trump boarded a military aircraft instead of flying aboard Air Force One from Turkey.

changes.title: Trump-backed Mike Lindell loses primary for Minnesota governor to Lisa Demuth
changes.summary: Lindell had President Trump's endorsement but he lost to Lisa Demuth, the speaker of the state house. She'll face Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar in the fall for governor. (Image credit: Ellen Schmidt).

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Trump boarded Air Force One last month as usual. But the Washington Post reports he was smuggled off the plane in a catering truck and flew on an entirely different aircraft due to a threat.

changes.title: Lisa Demuth Wins Republican Primary for Governor of Minnesota
changes.summary: Lisa Demuth beat Mike Lindell, the MyPillow founder who was endorsed by President Trump.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: The United States picked up multiple streams of information, including one potential threat that involved a shoulder-fired missile.

changes.title: He Was Deported to Eswatini in Southern Africa. He May Never Go Free.
changes.summary: As the Trump administration sends a growing number of immigrants to countries they have no connection to, some find themselves imprisoned with no way out.
